title: Phones and narrow windows — everything on the branch, with your words

steps.path: The strip across the top of the Android app
steps.headline: Top bar: ☰ and Projects on the left, + New session and terminal on the right, the plain name with status lights between.
steps.changed: Round 2 showed four bars. The one called "Two buttons each side" had ☰ and Projects left, + New session and terminal right. You wrote: "i want two buttons on each side from pair, a more simply styled name dropdown button kinda like drawer (i want the dropdown chevron, name, status indicator all to be in the same hover container). and maybe a row of indicator lights very small below the name?" Round 3 kept those four buttons and you picked the lights: "make it a bit prettier and clean up some of the dead space… lights can probably fade away in expanded view". Round 4: "Yes", plus "make the whole hoverable area of the current name dropdown button area clickable".
steps.notice: So + New session on the right came from the "pair" bar you named, not from a separate question. Nobody asked you about that button on its own. If you want different buttons beside the name, say which in the note.
steps.risk: Your branch-review note says you don't like that button; this slide only records how it got here.

steps.path: Tap the session name at the top of the Android app
steps.headline: Session list: same dropdown as today, now edge to edge, with tidier rows and a "Your sessions" heading.
steps.changed: Four small changes, each from an answer. Rows: status is a dot instead of the Working/Inactive word, the model shows without "YouCoded Coder ·", and the folder name gets room first. You wrote (round 1, Q-5): "i think we can condense while losing less information. between a/c". Heading: round 1 S-1, you chose "Change it" to "Your sessions". Shape: round 4 you picked "Drops down, full width" over "Slides up from the bottom" and "Its own screen". Lights under the name fade while it is open (your round 3 note).
steps.notice: It looks close to today on purpose: you picked the shape nearest today's. Compare the right edge of each row: today's model names are cut off ("Qwen2.5…", "GPT 5.6…"); here they are whole.
steps.risk: Wide windows keep today's list; only narrow screens get these rows.

steps.path: The pills under the message box, on a phone browser connected to your computer
steps.headline: Pills: one swipeable row, each pill shaped like the shortcut chips, Remote as a computer icon first.
steps.changed: Round 1 Q-3, about the REMOTE word in the top bar: "replace with a better styled always-on status bar chip". Q-6: you picked one scrolling row, "and maybe much smaller truncated or icon-based versions for each pill". Round 2: "every single element in that bottom row appears to have a unique style/size/height/roundness? and some of these need to be shortened, like remote." Round 3: "the spacing is very weird… they get too close to the edge". Round 4: "Yes", with "the fade effect seems a little broken on the right side", now fixed by letting the pencil scroll with the pills.
steps.notice: Your branch-review note asks for two more changes: a light computer icon with a green glow behind its outline, and much shorter pills. Those are next, after this record.
steps.measured: Pills are 32 px tall today on the branch, matching master's narrow-window chips

steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: In a narrow computer window the branch's top bar is broken: + lands on the name, terminal on the window buttons.
steps.changed: Round 1 Q-9 you chose "width decides": a narrow computer window gets the phone layout. Master's phone review later made the same rule. The pills below the message box come through fine here.
steps.notice: The top bar was only designed for a phone, which has no minimize, maximize or close buttons. Your note: "also the terminal and close/minimize/maximize overlap as well. and we need to think through how this would look on a mac." On a Mac those three buttons sit at the LEFT, so there ☰ and Projects would be the ones crowded.
steps.risk: Not fixable by shrinking the name alone; this needs its own design round.

steps.path: Journal, Inbox, Git Status… above the message box

steps.changed: Round 1 you asked to put them behind a button; round 2 built that, and you wrote: "nevermind, lets just leave the current row".
steps.notice: Nothing on the branch touches them. Master has since made them taller in narrow windows, which is why the pills grew to match.
